title: Winter Jam
seo_title: Winter Jam 2027 at Great Southern Bank Arena, Springfield
description: Winter Jam 2027 is a Christian music concert featuring Crowder, Anne Wilson, Andy Mineo ft. Magic & Bird, Strings & Heart, Terrian, Red, and NewSong, with a message from speaker Zane Black. A Pre-Jam Party with Natural State, CJ Emulous, and Mary-Clair starts earlier, and no advance tickets are required, with a $15 donation at the door. It takes place Friday, February 19, 2027, with doors at 6:00 PM and the show at 7:00 PM, at Great Southern Bank Arena in Springfield, MO.
